dedupe_keys.name: romania 2021 population and housing census rpl 2021 definitive tables on residential building stock and dwelling conditions to commune level

description: The National Institute of Statistics of Romania publishes the definitive results of the 2021 Population and Housing Census as downloadable tables. The residential building stock chapter has 14 tables: buildings, conventional dwellings, rooms and room floor area; buildings by ownership, wall material, connections and installations, construction period and number of floors; with table 7.12 giving buildings, dwellings, rooms and floor area for every county, municipality, town and commune (5,496,582 buildings and 9,929,935 conventional dwellings nationally). The dwellings and living conditions chapter has 27 tables, among them dwellings by window frame material and thermal rehabilitation, installations and annexes, cooking fuel and heating method, several by county and all by urban or rural area. Reference date: 1 December 2021. Many tables were marked revised and re-uploaded in February 2026. Format and access: XLSX tables, free to download without registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: tables are formatted for print with merged headers, the detailed breakdowns such as wall material or connections stop at county or urban and rural level, and revised tables replace earlier versions. Simulation uses: building stock age, material and height for seismic exposure, thermal rehabilitation and heating fuel for energy models, and utility connection shares. Related records: the EU building stock observatory and IPUMS International.
